title: boundary_allowlist.v1
description: Caller-supplied dated exceptions for vocabulary-boundary scanning. Matching combines a path glob and exact term. Expired matches do not allow the leak; their row reports allow_expired. The CLI checks the consumed shape before scanning.

entries.description: Declared source-context exceptions only; actual entries and expiry dates are owned by rules/boundary-allowlist.json. No exception grants measurement or adjudication authority.

entry.description: One declared exception: a path glob + exact vocabulary term this applies to, plus reason/expiry/ADR (underwrite.cli.boundary.AllowlistEntry).

path_glob.description: fnmatch pattern against the scanned file's path exactly as given on the command line (repo-relative when invoked the documented way, from the repo root).

term.description: Exact vocabulary term this entry allows (underwrite_core.boundary.Leak.term) -- case-sensitive, no glob.

expiry.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); compared against the caller-supplied --now (no wall-clock fallback).

adr.description: The ADR that authorizes this exception.
